INSERT INTO t_employee ( id, organization_id, user_id, employee_no, name, email, department, position, employment_status, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT employee_seq.NEXTVAL, #{organizationId}, NULL, 'ORG' || LPAD(#{organizationId}, 3, '0') || '-EMP' || LPAD(#{startIndex} + LEVEL - 1, 5, '0'), CASE MOD(#{startIndex} + LEVEL - 1, 10) WHEN 0 THEN '김' WHEN 1 THEN '이' WHEN 2 THEN '박' WHEN 3 THEN '최' WHEN 4 THEN '정' WHEN 5 THEN '강' WHEN 6 THEN '조' WHEN 7 THEN '윤' WHEN 8 THEN '장' ELSE '임' END || CASE MOD(#{startIndex} + LEVEL - 1, 20) WHEN 0 THEN '민수' WHEN 1 THEN '서준' WHEN 2 THEN '지우' WHEN 3 THEN '예진' WHEN 4 THEN '하윤' WHEN 5 THEN '도윤' WHEN 6 THEN '지민' WHEN 7 THEN '서연' WHEN 8 THEN '현우' WHEN 9 THEN '수연' WHEN 10 THEN '태민' WHEN 11 THEN '다은' WHEN 12 THEN '유진' WHEN 13 THEN '지호' WHEN 14 THEN '서윤' WHEN 15 THEN '도현' WHEN 16 THEN '지원' WHEN 17 THEN '준호' WHEN 18 THEN '소연' ELSE '민재' END, 'employee-' || #{organizationId} || '-' || (#{startIndex} + LEVEL - 1) || '@ttait.local', CASE MOD(#{startIndex} + LEVEL - 1, 8) WHEN 0 THEN '개발팀' WHEN 1 THEN '인사팀' WHEN 2 THEN '기획팀' WHEN 3 THEN '운영팀' WHEN 4 THEN '마케팅팀' WHEN 5 THEN '디자인팀' WHEN 6 THEN '영업팀' ELSE '전략팀' END, CASE MOD(#{startIndex} + LEVEL - 1, 5) WHEN 0 THEN '사원' WHEN 1 THEN '주임' WHEN 2 THEN '대리' WHEN 3 THEN '과장' ELSE '차장' END, 'ACTIVE', SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= #{count}
